questions.q: What did Mr. Fogg usually do on the Rangoon?
choices: Walked the deck and talked with the crew
Stayed in the cabin with Aouda or played whist
Read newspapers in the ship's library
Wrote letters to his friends at the Reform Club
questions.evidence: where he kept Aouda company, or, according to his inveterate habit, took a hand at whist

questions.q: What did Passepartout wrongly decide Fix must be?
choices: A thief planning to steal his master's bag
A Reform Club spy
A detective hired by the Bank of England
A sailor looking for work on the next ship
questions.evidence: He's a spy sent to keep us in view!

questions.q: Why did Passepartout decide not to tell Mr. Fogg about Fix?
choices: He was afraid Fogg would blame him for talking to strangers
He didn't want Fogg hurt by his club's mistrust
He wanted to keep the secret and earn a reward himself
He thought Fogg already knew everything about Fix
questions.evidence: lest he should be justly offended at this mistrust on the part of his adversaries

questions.q: Why did the Rangoon stop at Singapore?
choices: To pick up mail for the Chinese ports
To receive coal
To repair a broken engine valve
To let the sick passengers go ashore

questions.q: What did Fix do while Fogg and Aouda drove around Singapore?
choices: He sent a telegram and then went back to his cabin
He followed them carefully, keeping them in sight
He went shopping with Passepartout in the town
He stayed on board and searched Fogg's cabin
questions.evidence: followed them cautiously, without being himself perceived

questions.q: What did Passepartout buy in Singapore and share with Aouda?
choices: A basket of fresh nutmegs
Several dozen mangoes
A bunch of cloves
A box of pepper

questions.q: Why did Fogg want to reach Hong Kong in six days?
choices: Aouda's cousin was leaving Hong Kong for good on the 6th of November
To catch the steamer for Yokohama leaving on the 6th of November
The warrant for his arrest was due on the 6th
His bet said he must be in China by the 6th
questions.evidence: in time for the steamer which would leave on the 6th of November for Yokohama

questions.q: What was one reason Passepartout was so impatient about the delays?
choices: He was seasick and wanted to get off the ship
The gas was still burning at his expense back in Saville Row
He had a bet of his own with the ship's cook
He had promised to meet some of Fix's friends at a hotel in Hong Kong
questions.evidence: the gas, which was remorselessly burning at his expense in Saville Row

questions.q: When Fix said he didn't believe in the trip, what did Passepartout call him?
choices: A sly dog
A liar
A good fellow
A spy

questions.q: Passepartout kept "chaffing" Fix with hints and jokes. What does "chaffing" mean here?
choices: Teasing in a friendly way
Shouting at in anger
Begging for help
Paying no attention to

questions.q: How did Passepartout's teasing make Fix feel?
choices: Pleased, since it meant Passepartout trusted him
Puzzled and worried that he had been found out
Angry enough to report Passepartout to the captain
Bored, because he did not understand the joke

questions.q: What did Passepartout think about his master and Aouda?
choices: That Fogg was secretly in love with her
That Fogg must be quite heartless, since her charms had no effect
That Aouda did not like Fogg at all
That they would surely be married as soon as they arrived in Hong Kong
questions.evidence: must be, he thought, quite heartless

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: The voyage to Hong Kong, as Fix and Passepartout each suspect the other
Fogg and Aouda's long holiday in the gardens of Singapore
A fierce storm that forces the Rangoon to turn back
Passepartout repairing the steam engine on the Rangoon
questions.evidence: Such was the situation between Fix and Passepartout.
